Resolves #21063

`apps/webdesktop` is a new demo app that answers the community question behind #21061: navigation that follows the signed-in account's permissions.

- The account's permission keys live in the root `state.Provider`.
- The provider writes them into the single permission filter of one `TreeStore` that holds every app and group.
- The launcher is a `list.Base` over the store's kept projection, with groups rendered as headers. The start menu is a `menu.List` cascade over the same store. Both are bound to that store and follow it.
- A permissions panel grants and revokes permissions on the live session.
- The Portal lists the demo among its featured examples.

#21068 merged on 2026-11-16. This branch now carries #21077's commit (`3a1dec8924`), the menu collapse fix the review found, until #21077 merges. The shell is `40620aa25e`; the review repairs are `92714caa50` and `a38389bc2e`.

Evidence: L3 (a real browser on the local dev server: four accounts, live grants and revokes, both neo themes, an empty console) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3, AC-5 and AC-6 are rendered-UI claims). No residuals.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 boots in both neo themes without console errors | Outside CI: dev server at `apps/webdesktop/index.html`, dark by default, light through the taskbar toggle; the console error read stayed empty throughout. |
| AC-2 sign-in lists the accounts from `accounts.json` through a store `url` | Outside CI: all four accounts rendered from the JSON, and clicking each one signed in. |
| AC-3 each account sees exactly its permitted apps, and empty groups are absent | CI: `test/playwright/unit/apps/webdesktop/view/ViewportStateProvider.spec.mjs` "granted keys reach the filter, and a group shows exactly when one of its apps does" and "every start-menu level follows the same filter, live". Outside CI (screenshots in the authoring session): Administrator sees all five groups. Editor's launcher shows Communication (Mail, Calendar), Media (Photos), Files (Documents) and Support (Help), with no System group; the start menu has no System, and its Communication submenu lists Mail and Calendar. Guest sees Support (Help). Suspended sees nothing. |
| AC-4 no permissions gives an empty desktop; the default would show every app | CI: "nobody signed in: the apps store keeps nothing" and "an empty grant stays closed, where the default includeEmptyValues would show every app" (a store with the default flag shows all 16 nodes). Outside CI: the Suspended account shows the locked empty state. |
| AC-5 toggling updates in place, and the view instances survive | CI: "the launcher renders the kept projection" (one launcher instance across grants), the start-menu test (the same level instances) and "a permission row states its grant to assistive technology, and a toggle updates the same row". Outside CI: on the Editor, granting Messages and revoking Documents updated the launcher and removed the Files group, without a reload. |
| AC-6 signing out returns to sign-in with no permission carried over | Outside CI: the Administrator revoked Help and signed out; the Guest then signed in and saw exactly Help. |
| AC-7 visibility is decided in one place | Code: `store/Apps.mjs` holds the only filter, and `ViewportStateProvider#onDataPropertyChange` is its only writer. The start button's `disabled` binding and the empty-state hint read `permissions.length`, never an app's visibility. |
| AC-8 README | `apps/webdesktop/README.md` |
| AC-9 Portal entry | `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` has a featured `webdesktop` entry whose `feature` and `lookFor` name the proof. The catalog contract in `TabContainerController.spec.mjs` is updated (75 → 76 examples, 27 → 28 featured). |
| AC-10 unit specs green | CI: unit job. |

## Deltas from ticket

- `.gitignore` ignores `/apps/**/*.mjs`, `*.html` and `neo-config.json`; every app opts back in with three negation lines, and this one adds its own.
- A light/dark toggle in the taskbar makes both themes reachable without a URL parameter.
- `model/Permission.mjs` and `store/Permissions.mjs` feed the permissions panel from the same catalog export as the apps store, so there is no second list.
- The Portal entry uses `image: null` (the typographic card). Covers are served from `neomjs/pages`, so a cover can follow once the desktop has windows (#21064).
- The entry is placed second among the featured examples, after Workstation. The Featured order is curated under #20498; moving the entry only changes the pinned order in `TabContainerController.spec.mjs`.
- Review repairs: the permission list is a multiselectable `listbox` whose options carry their grant as `aria-selected` (the `Neo.list.ValuePicker` idiom), the icon-only theme button is named "Switch theme" (`92714caa50`), and an app arm pins the carried collapse fix: the open Communication level survives `collapse`/`expand`, and the last revoke closes it (`a38389bc2e`).

## Test Evidence

I ran mutation probes in a disposable worktree at the original head, over its 5 tests:

- With a fail-open filter (`includeEmptyValues: true`), 2 of the 5 fail: "nobody signed in…" and "an empty grant stays closed…".
- When the provider never writes the filter, 3 of the 5 fail: the filter, launcher and start-menu tests.

The three review arms ran red in disposable worktrees: the two accessibility arms on `40620aa25e`, and the collapse arm with `src/menu/List.mjs` at `d940179245` (without `3a1dec8924`).

For the browser witness (local dev server, Chromium in the app's browser pane), the steps are listed per AC above. The console error read stayed empty after every step.

## Post-Merge Validation

- None: the CI-covered ACs run in CI, and the rendered ACs were witnessed above.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge:** With all permissions intact, open two cascading levels, collapse their ancestor in the source tree, then expand it. The base restores the rows and retains the open grandchild. The new orphan check uses the temporary absence from the level’s flat store. I sent the reproduction to Euclid, who holds the upstream review seat.
